description:
1. Replacement of all existing timber windows with new uPVC double-glazed windows, designed to match the existing style, proportions and appearance of the dwelling. Existing window openings to remain the same size.

2. Removal of the existing rear ground floor window measuring approximately 199cm wide x 146cm high, and installation of new patio doors measuring approximately 199cm wide x 221cm high within the same opening.

3. Removal of the existing rear patio door and adjoining window arrangement measuring approximately 184cm wide overall, and replacement with a single new window measuring approximately 184cm wide x 60cm high. Works to include infill brickwork to match the existing external brickwork as closely as possible in colour, texture and bond.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

[Rehau JULIAN Works order item 1-6, proposed rear elevation, proposed ground floor plan]

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Front and Rear elevation windows: Double-glazed, Rehau heritage uPVC frames, with sash horns and external glazing bars (white finish) to match existing windows.

-	Rear door: uPVC door to match existing.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC6 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
